location: 301 S. Silver Avenue, Deming, New Mexico 88030

building.name: 1916 National Guard Armory
building.historical_status: Listed on the National Register of Historic Places
building.history: Built in 1916 for the New Mexico National Guard Company I during border tensions. Later used as a community hall, armory, and finally established as the county museum.

mimbres_pottery.culture: Mimbres branch of the Mogollon culture (~5,000 people along Mimbres River in Luna, Grant, and Hidalgo counties)
mimbres_pottery.significance: World-famous black-on-white and red-on-white painted ceramic bowls depicting realistic wildlife, weddings, ceremonies, grandfathers telling stories, and daily life.
mimbres_pottery.tools_materials: Painted with chewed yucca leaf brushes using natural mineral earth pigments.
mimbres_pottery.kill_hole: Ceremonial puncture in the center of burial pottery to release the vessel's spirit, often placed over the head of the deceased.
mimbres_pottery.geography: Mimbres valley was the only natural low-land route from Atlantic to Pacific without mountains, why the transcontinental railroad and I-10 pass through Deming.

quilt_collection.size: One of the largest hand-stitched quilt displays in the American Southwest.
quilt_collection.popular_styles: Crazy Quilts, Log Cabin, Wedding Ring, feedsack fabrics, tatting lace.
quilt_collection.oldest_quilt: Hand-woven spread circa 1820 donated in memory of Bessie Gomer May, key founder of the museum.
quilt_collection.lottie_deno_thurman: Intricate tatting lace altar cloth handcrafted by Mrs. Frank Thurman (Lottie Deno), famous frontier gambler who inspired Miss Kitty in Gunsmoke.

dolls_and_toys.auburn_rubber: Auburn Rubber Company, the largest producer of rubber and vinyl toys in America/world, moved molds from Auburn, Indiana to Deming in 1959–1960.
dolls_and_toys.pancho_villa_doll: Doll belonging to the daughter of the telephone operator who called in the March 9, 1916 Columbus raid; survived bullets breaking the window above her bed.
dolls_and_toys.hiroshima_doll: Japanese doll with real hair recovered from the ashes of Hiroshima by an American soldier and donated to the museum.
dolls_and_toys.room_history: Originally a small-caliber indoor shooting range for National Guard soldiers, converted to a USO bowling alley during World War II alongside the adjoining Old Timers' Room.

transportation_annex.railroad: Meeting of Santa Fe and Southern Pacific on March 18, 1881, driving the silver spike for the 2nd transcontinental railroad; Deming named for Mary Deming-Crocker.
transportation_annex.harvey_house: One of the grandest Harvey Houses in the Southwest; America's first restaurant chain; staffed by Harvey Girls; original lumber and paint preserved.
transportation_annex.train_station: Original Deming train station sign on display; historic station building relocated to North Country Club Road.
transportation_annex.vehicles: Deming's first fire truck with interactive bell and siren, the 1904 REO (first car owned in Deming), and historic El Paso soap box derby racers.

geodes_and_minerals.collection: The Geode Kid Collection of geodes, thundereggs, petrified wood, fossils, and minerals from Luna County & Mimbres Valley.
geodes_and_minerals.geodes_vs_thundereggs: Geodes are hollow chambers lined with sparkling crystals (formed when mineral-rich water fills vesicles); thundereggs are spherical nodules formed in rhyolitic volcanic ash with centers of chalcedony, agate, jasper, and opal.
geodes_and_minerals.rockhound_state_park: Located southeast of Deming; one of the rare state parks in the US where visitors are legally permitted to collect and keep agates, thundereggs, and minerals.

bataan_death_march.history: April 9–17, 1942: ~75,000 American and Filipino POWs forced on 65-mile march from Mariveles to Camp O'Donnell under extreme brutality.
bataan_death_march.casualties: Out of 1,816 men in the NM 200th & 515th units, 829 died in battle, in captivity, or post-liberation; 987 survived.
bataan_death_march.local_veterans: 83 Luna County residents listed on museum plaque, with 30 killed in action; Lee Gardner family shadowbox on display.
bataan_death_march.memorial_march: Annual 26.2-mile Bataan Memorial Death March held each spring at White Sands Missile Range since 1989.

western_area.ranching_hub: Deming transitioned from a railroad junction into a major agriculture and cattle ranching center.
western_area.diamond_a_chuckwagon: Authentic chuckwagon from the Diamond A Ranch in Hachita, NM, crafted from multiple wagons; last used on a drive in 1972.
western_area.chuckwagon_supplies: Loaded with cast-iron pans, Dutch ovens, water barrels, branding irons, flour, cornmeal, pinto beans, green coffee beans, salt pork, beef jerky, bacon.
western_area.ruebush_saddlery: Historic Saddlery on Silver Street (1930s–1970s) where local ranching saddles were custom made.
western_area.cowboy_hats: Hats donated by local ranchers where unique brim creases, tilts, and shapes served as distant visual IDs on the open range.

medical_room.era: 1930s to 1950s healthcare in Luna County & Southwest New Mexico
medical_room.iron_lungs: Adult and child iron lungs donated by the former Deming Memorial Hospital, used during the 1949 and 1952 polio epidemics.
medical_room.birthing_chair: Antique wooden birthing chair imported from Spain.
medical_room.hospitals_represented: Deming Memorial Hospital, Ladies Hospital, Faywood Hot Springs, Camp Cody Red Cross Building & Infirmary, and Holy Cross Hospital (tuberculosis sanitarium).
medical_room.holy_cross_sanitarium: Nun doll and historical research paper donated by the Holy Cross Order of South Bend, Indiana, documenting their establishment of the sanitarium in Deming.

old_timers_room.railroad_water_stop: Deming was founded in 1881 where Santa Fe and Southern Pacific tracks met to drive the silver spike (second transcontinental railroad). Locomotives could only travel ~60 miles between water refills; Deming sits almost exactly 60 miles from Las Cruces, Lordsburg, and Silver City, making it the perfect natural water stop.
old_timers_room.old_timers_tradition: Started around 1900 by local businessmen known as 'The Old Timers'. Annual October reunions, banquet, and dance constitute the longest continuously running celebration in New Mexico (113+ years of association presidents).
old_timers_room.photo_displays: Originally displayed in Mahoney's Hardware Store windows; now housed in wrought-iron photo racks built in the early 1980s by Harold Measday.

main_room.architecture: Exposed timber roof trusses, soaring ceilings, red-brick construction.
main_room.history: Built in 1916 for the New Mexico National Guard Company I during Southwestern border tensions; later repurposed as community center and historical museum.

pancho_villa_raid.location: Columbus, NM (30 miles south of Deming)
pancho_villa_raid.general: General John J. Pershing led the Punitive Expedition out of Camp Furlong into Mexico.

nearby_attractions: Rockhound State Park (12 miles SE) - Geode & mineral hunting
City of Rocks State Park (28 miles N) - Unique volcanic rock monolith formations
Columbus, NM & Pancho Villa State Park (30 miles S)
local_deming_info.dining_and_hospitality: Deming is famous for Southwestern New Mexican cuisine, green chile dishes, local wineries (St. Clair / Lescombes Winery), and friendly local hospitality.

faqs.q: How long does a typical tour take?
faqs.a: Visitors usually spend between 1 to 2 hours exploring our 15 featured spaces and 47 exhibit rooms.
